ideas.name: Fridge-first meal planner
ideas.description: An app that helps people plan meals around what is already in their fridge, with recipes that adapt to dietary needs.

ideas.name: Flexible home workouts
ideas.description: A fitness app that builds short home workouts around the time and energy I have each day.

ideas.name: Shared household budget
ideas.description: A simple budgeting app that helps couples split shared bills, track subscriptions, and save for a goal together.

ideas.name: Daily routine coach
ideas.description: An app that helps me build a calmer daily routine with gentle reminders and progress tracking.
